entries.explanation: Combines the positive case into a bounded partnership that accepts empirical correction without presenting compatibility or community benefits as proof of supernatural claims.
Develops scientific correction into a credibility condition: genuine rejection of readings demonstrates constraint without claiming that surviving interpretations are thereby verified.
Retains the distinction between mechanism and significance while limiting the football comparison to human moral uptake rather than inferring an external cosmic author.
Adds an institutional account of sustaining costly commitments while expressly allowing secular replacement and withholding any inference to doctrinal truth.
Unifies the critical case around independent warrant while preserving practical cooperation and distinguishing an unwarranted explanatory partnership from impossible coexistence.
Introduces reciprocal error correction as a partnership test, extending the unresolved purpose and creator warrants without denying the conceded interpretive rule.
Converts the speculative secular substitute into a comparative institutional test that identifies mechanisms and does not assume that an effective replacement already exists.
Distinguishes normative standards from measurable objects and offers secular justificatory routes, challenging the inference from scientific evidential limits to necessary transcendence.

notes: The affirmative section is expressly a bounded practical and interpretive partnership; it does not silently claim that the football analogy proves cosmic purpose.
The negative section allows cooperation while demanding independent explanatory warrant, avoiding a caricature that scientific naturalism precludes shared moral practice.

The six reinforcing arguments respectively address empirical constraint, moral uptake, institutional continuity, reciprocal correction, functional replaceability, and the category distinction between norms and measurements. Their openings and paragraph progressions follow different substantive claims rather than interchangeable provenance frames.
